title: Russian Quiche
description: A classic Russian-inspired quiche with a flaky crust and a rich, creamy filling.

ingredients.name: Russian eggs
ingredients.notes: Large eggs are best for this recipe.

ingredients.name: quiche crust
ingredients.notes: Homemade or store-bought quiche crust works well.

ingredients.name: aerated milk
ingredients.notes: Heavy cream or half-and-half works well.

ingredients.name: yellowed cheese
ingredients.notes: Grated cheese, such as cheddar or mozzarella.

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.notes: Melted butter for brushing the crust.

instructions: Roll out the quiche crust and place it in a tart pan.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, aerated milk, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Add the grated cheese to the bowl and stir to combine.
Pour the egg mixture into the quiche crust.
Brush the edges of the crust with melted butter.
Bake the quiche for 35-40 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown and the center is set.
Remove the quiche from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Serve the quiche warm, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
